description: Codex: Space Marines (11e) MERCILESS VETERANS (Terminator Storm Force, 1 CP) — WP-M3b (SMCodexB.gd, through the custom:sm11e dispatcher). Fixture sm11e_m3b_active (P1 Space Marines ACTIVE vs P2 Orks, round 2; layout in tests/helpers/gen_sm11e_m3b_fixtures.gd). Setup privilege: the Terminator Squad steps 5" back out of its fight (so it can use normal shooting). SELECT_SHOOTER (the shooting panel's unit pick) opens unit_selected_to_shoot; a real click on 'Use on Terminator Squad' spends 1 CP; its ranged attacks have [LETHAL HITS] and [SUSTAINED HITS 1] (attack aggregator), not its melee attacks; the squad then shoots the Kommandos.

steps.comment: setup privilege: the Space Marines player gets the eight WP-M2b detachments (stratagems reloaded), auto wound allocation, the other player 0 CP (no stratagem windows not under test)
steps.equals: Terminator Storm Force + Assault Brethren + Gravis Linebreaker Force + Devastator Brethren + Gravis Siege Force + Tactical Brethren + Ironclad Champions + Tacticus Firestorm Force

steps.comment: setup privilege: straight to the phase under test
a window not under test (if any) is declined
REAL click (the Space Marines player) on the stratagem's Use button
a window not under test (if any) is declined
the unit shoots (the shooting panel's SHOOT)
